result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot CRM** as the best all-around choice. It's relatively easy to learn, has a useful free version, and can grow with your business.

However, the best choice depends on whether you're managing sales, customer relationships, marketing, or all three.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

![HubSpot + Outbound Best Practices: How to Build a Predictable Pipeline Engine](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fRaXjaIhlPuB-R-vp4pPeoGZlftvdgXSxyn6Q2rF42Kvv67ncid10g7lK3I8Ts0KBOUtWU1e_TFh69Ct3Yd7iXz5hetANX31x3M_throOc-8gj_ptcYrP0lMRBY1bi8qNHq1cblhhZaZ0YHkqql9Vi2haPe6jLaATcrIrrFWSWPloM1A0RgNH3M1Ze3FRXoV?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot**

(Best overall)

- Free plan available
- Contact and deal management
- Email tracking and sales pipeline
- Marketing and customer service tools

Best for teams wanting everything in one place.

[Explore HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![30MPC Masterclass | Pipedrive](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YXtK01sDnPYRmrgl-cq3FoFz_gi03_11mtWIHg1kzW5LP-eLYfON-4AW8Be22mb410EXqHg1l_NK3GQkL0OnZs_wo-cAhYHW7JLl_VjWui99Y_oYNiabMsX1QWg6He98qMA1qCh9iTsRxLcxXEYyZcd4w83XvE6jKhETG-afSiGIXEQdSFY0k5LqqYHz7Qmi?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Very intuitive visual pipeline
- Tracks leads and deals
- Follow-up reminders
- Sales reporting and automation

Best if your team focuses on converting prospects into customers.

[Explore Pipedrive](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![Systemy CRM przykłady dostępnych na rynku](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ozMKHOYgPNfTodqTy1-KuVP1BizKKwV3DxjmrLeH0xvcXQhJ5tVhP4VMMyJczdNuqh3Ft03_r89Z0P8-xNGaL4RX9OpJOBUAIEnC_fB03hMcujhg2ceKlJF93NeMPkhu7eb5fgJK2TTEETAI6NrVPxoPMqY0QeuibcH6sMr3VU0hzlJzfPFgfFss2Oq2HIS3?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

(Best value)

- Free plan for up to 3 users
- Strong customization
- Workflow automation
- Broad business software ecosystem

Best if you want lots of features without spending much.

[Explore Zoho CRM](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Freshsales – AI-Powered CRM for Efficient Sales & Customer Management – Daidu.ai](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/y7Vb4xAcRAAEuqjagQXpFAF7AnuXMUElBxy4BgPXr8eZYF7Dkte6UvmlzH7N7Gng8CLjCWbvU78ky87jsrjvYxdASFZf0fX5TJAm3axZjmliiRYYmBFh9H4s49unQfi71zpX0ByRdXwVVL50YsRCn7JH7nOSk0tgkqnFMggeUC_Qb730HNfnItPlsuAKqMt-?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Free plan for up to 3 users
- Built-in phone, email and chat features
- Lead scoring
- Sales automation

Best for teams that communicate with prospects frequently.

[Explore Freshsales](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![Spring Cleaning tips for your CRM |  LACRM Blog](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SjmS2Yd3QRSYtW7we0OT-umLK_Q9f_YvngFBZov551NCJSxZIbrMjQ-iN-5MH2HSLTaEC54esf8sWYz9oM-gbrLUqEJQH3PsaZ5Hz2P1q8ZYJwHaY-Yyok2F3J4ZOsScAX3MFpNZoEI7i2nj_NF0QmdvKaibAoM_heWa82Ov3znEZO7CryGtDBrtvsMsgQ-K?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Less Annoying CRM**

- Straightforward interface
- Simple contact management
- Calendar and task management
- Flat per-user pricing

Best if you want something simple without a complicated setup.

[Explore Less Annoying CRM](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/)

## Quick comparison

| CRM | Best for | Starting price\* |
|--------|--------|--------|
| HubSpot | Overall | Free |
| Pipedrive | Sales pipeline | \$14/user/mo |
| Zoho | Value and features | \$14/user/mo |
| Freshsales | Sales communication | \$9/user/mo |
| Less Annoying CRM | Simplicity | \$15/user/mo |


\*Approximate USD prices, generally based on annual billing. Plans, promotions and limits vary. Verify current pricing before purchasing.

These are strong candidates in current 2026 comparisons.
